admin0RelationOverride.reason: Owner decision 2026-10-13: non-sovereign territories are in scope. Saint Pierre and Miquelon (PM) is a French overseas collectivity, not a sovereign state. In OpenStreetMap the only relation carrying ISO3166-1=PM is relation 3406826 (boundary=administrative, admin_level 3, ISO3166-2=FR-PM, 2 member ways, both present in the pinned OpenStreetMap France saint_pierre_et_miquelon mirror of 2026-10-13), so the default admin-0 rule (admin_level=2) finds none. Game venue map only: no claims about real operations, borders or sovereignty; OSM mapped boundary, not legal-border authority. Every other proof (member ways, area assembly, segment match) still applies.
